title: Design Nested API Response
prompt:
Design resource data plus pagination metadata and a documented error shape.

target_skills: Apply design nested api response to a realistic but synthetic structured-data case.
Validate syntax and relevant type/schema semantics.
Document observed evidence, failure behavior, and version assumptions.

expected_output: A reviewable artifact for Design Nested API Response that meets the acceptance criteria and explains a valid, invalid, and boundary outcome.
acceptance_criteria: The artifact demonstrates the stated objective: Design Nested API Response.
The expected result is written before verification.
At least one invalid or boundary case is included.
The validation tool/version and any compatibility/security limitations are recorded.
No secrets or personal production data appear in submitted fixtures.
hints: Start with the smallest example that demonstrates the requested concept.
Change only one field, syntax detail, or constraint at a time.
Compare the observed result with the expected behavior and use a standards/source link if it differs.
grading_method: Automated exact-string smoke check plus human review of technical correctness, test evidence, edge cases, and reproducibility. The existing grader does not execute arbitrary JSON/YAML parsers, shell commands, or general programs.
retry_policy: Allow retries after reviewing feedback; platform-wide XP and idempotency rules control rewards. No per-exercise XP override is authored.
